171  float v_ms = std::sqrt(c*c*(v_A*v_A+v_s*v_s)/(v_A*v_A+c*c)) ;
172  float lambda_D = std::sqrt(eps0*k_B*Te_inf/(n0_no_norm*e*e)) ;
